record.dic_text:
406 Andreas {an-dreh'-as}

源自 435; 陽性專有名詞

欽定本 - Andrew 13; 13

安得烈 = "有男子氣概的"
1) 加利利的伯賽大人,是西門彼得的兄弟, 原為施洗約翰的門徒,
   後來成為基督的門徒,據說後來也被釘死.
record.edic_text:
406 Andreas {an-dreh'-as}

from 435;; n pr m

AV - Andrew 13; 13

Andrew = "manly"
1) A native of Bethsaida in Galilee, brother of Simon Peter, a
   disciple of John the Baptist, and afterwards an apostle of
   Christ. He is said to have been crucified at Patrae in Archaia.
